case_number: 2024 INSC 316; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (CRL.) NO.9122 OF 2021)

parties.respondent: The State Of Uttar Pradesh & Anr.

summary: Validity of cognizance order after police closure report; Magistrate improperly relied on affidavits in Protest Petition to take cognizance under Section 190(1)(b) Cr.P.C. instead of treating it as private complaint under Section 200 Cr.P.C.; Supreme Court distinguished between material in case diary and additional evidence in Protest Petition; reliance on Vishnu Kumar Tiwari (2019) for requirement to follow Chapter XV Cr.P.C. when using affidavits; error in proceeding as State case; dismissal of Section 482 petition by High Court set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order dismissing Section 482 petition quashed; Magistrate's cognizance order modified to require fresh proceedings as private complaint under Chapter XV Cr.P.C.
